title: Her,
in little moments.
site.subtitle: A collection of the photographs I couldn't simply scroll past.
site.privacyLine: Not a gallery. Just a few pieces of you I wanted to keep.
site.closingSub: Although I could probably keep saving photographs of you forever.
site.emptyBody: Add the photographs you want to keep here. Each one will get its own page, its own light, and its own sentence.
site.emptyHint: Drop images into public/photos, then list them in src/data/gallery.json.
site.tagline: a little film, in five chapters

chapters.title: The Girl I Keep Looking At
chapters.subtitle: Where it quietly begins.
chapters.epigraph: It started the way these things always start — with me, looking a little too long.

chapters.title: Little Smiles
chapters.subtitle: The ones you don't know you're making.
chapters.epigraph: Some people smile with their whole face. You smile with the whole room.

chapters.title: The Photographs I Saved
chapters.subtitle: Kept, on purpose.
chapters.epigraph: Saved, the way you save the last bite of something good.

chapters.title: Things I Don't Say Enough
chapters.subtitle: So I'm writing them instead.
chapters.epigraph: Words I keep in my pocket and keep forgetting to hand over.

chapters.title: My Favorite Versions of You
chapters.subtitle: All of them, honestly.
chapters.epigraph: Every one of them. Even the menace.

photos.alt: Her soft almost-smile by the window, warm light through the curtain
photos.title: Where the light found you
photos.quote: The curtain, the late light, that almost-smile. I've looked at this photograph more times than I'm prepared to admit.

photos.alt: Her by the window with a small knowing smile
photos.quote: You were about to say something here. I don't remember what. I remember everything else.

photos.alt: A close crop of just her eyes
photos.title: Just your eyes
photos.quote: You cut the photograph down to only your eyes, as if that would make it less dangerous. It did not.

photos.alt: Her grinning widely, hair in loose curls
photos.title: That smile
photos.quote: There it is. The smile I'd cross any number of ordinary days to get to.
photos.caption: If I could only keep one, it might be this one. Don't tell the others.

photos.alt: Her laughing hard with her nose scrunched up
photos.quote: Your nose does the scrunch thing and honestly, the rest of the world can wait.

photos.alt: Her laughing in a camo hat and white shirt, bright window behind
photos.title: The hat
photos.quote: You, a borrowed hat, and a laugh loud enough to show up in a silent photograph.
photos.caption: This one looks like it was taken years ago and somehow still feels like right now.

photos.alt: Her calm and composed, by the old green door
photos.quote: Nothing happening. Just you, a quiet afternoon, and me — somewhere on the other side of this photograph, completely done for.
photos.caption: Chapter three begins with you pretending not to pose.

photos.alt: Her in the yellow-green dress with the jeweled necklace, looking aside
photos.title: The yellow-green dress
photos.quote: You weren't even looking at the camera and still managed to make this the most important photograph of the week.
photos.caption: The necklace tried its best to compete.

photos.alt: Her rolling her eyes sideways in the yellow-green dress
photos.quote: The eye-roll. Directed at me, probably. Worth it, definitely.
photos.note: I said something dumb, I assume

photos.alt: Her glancing at the camera, lips pressed in a half-smirk
photos.quote: Caught between a thought and a smirk. I'd like to know the thought. I'd settle for the smirk.

photos.alt: Her with bangs down, pouting softly by the curtain
photos.quote: This pout has ended arguments before they started. I hope you know that.
photos.caption: For the record: whatever it was, you won.

photos.alt: Her in the green top, giving the camera a full pout
photos.quote: I don't say it enough, so this page will: even on the days you feel like this, you are still the best part of mine.

photos.alt: Her looking straight into the camera, serious and steady
photos.quote: You look like you're deciding something here. I hope, whatever it was, you decided to stay.

photos.alt: Her quiet and unposed, by the green door
photos.quote: I notice you. Every version. Including this quiet one that nobody else gets to see.

photos.alt: Her sticking her tongue out at the camera
photos.title: Exhibit A
photos.quote: The menace. Zero seriousness detected. Ten out of ten, would be teased by you again.

photos.alt: Her soft and unbothered in the morning light of her room
photos.quote: Soft light, an ordinary room, and you in the middle of it looking like the only finished thing.
photos.caption: Taken on an ordinary day. Kept for the rest of them.

photos.alt: A close, warm photograph of her smiling gently
photos.title: Closer
photos.quote: Yes. This is the distance I like best.
photos.caption: The last one, for now. It felt right to end here.

littleThings.text: The way you smile when you're trying not to.
The random things you tell me.
The way you somehow make an ordinary conversation last forever.
The little moments I never want to lose.
The three seconds before you laugh, when you try to hold it in.
The way your voice changes when you talk about something you love.
How you say 'nothing' when it's clearly something — and I get to find out what.
How you remember the small things I only mentioned once.
That you exist, mostly. That one's hard to beat.
